description: The tickets on sale for one event on XP: section, row, quantity and the all-in price per ticket in dollars (per_ticket_usd), filterable by quantity, price, section, general admission and parking -- 'cheap seats', 'parking for the game'. event_id comes from search_events, search_market or get_event_details; each listing's uvid is what buy_tickets takes. error_code NO_INVENTORY: the event has nothing listed right now, and retrying will not change that. NO_MATCHING_TICKETS: tickets exist but none fit the filters. EVENT_NOT_FOUND: the event_id is wrong.

event_id.description: Event identifier from search_events or get_event_details.

is_ga.description: If true, filter for general admission only.

max_cache_level.description: Backend cache level override (advanced; usually omit).

max_price_usd.description: Maximum all-in price per ticket in dollars.

min_price_usd.description: Minimum all-in price per ticket in dollars.

parking_only.description: If true, return only parking tickets.

section_ids.description: Section IDs filter (list, comma-separated string, or numeric IDs; supports simple ranges like '100-110').

name: get_ticket_listings
title: Get Ticket Listings
